text:
marco: heads up team — following the Go quickstart from the partner template and my first API call fails with 402 even though console shows billing active. using a service-account token that our infra pipeline created. any obvious fixes?

marco: snippet I run locally: ```bash
export RW_KEY=SA-PARTNER-999
go run ./examples/quickstart-go
```

marco: SDK prints: `error: request failed (402) {"error":"payment_required","message":"billing_handshake_incomplete"}`

devon_devex: thanks! couple things to check quickly: 1) was the workspace created by a partner integration or terraform provider? 2) is the SA token actually minted in that same workspace org, or did infra create it in a central infra org?

marco: workspace was provisioned via our partner terraform module (workspace id org-p-314). infra pipeline generates SA keys centrally and then writes them into the partner repo secrets. i think that's the central org token.

devon_devex: yep that pattern explains it. tokens that live in a different org won't be mapped to the newly-provisioned workspace until token->tenant mapping runs and billing handshake completes. invite/partner flows frequently require an explicit billing acceptance step before trials are provisioned.

marco: console shows Billing: Active for org-p-314 though. i tried regenerating a token in the partner repo but CI can't hit the console to do UI steps.

devon_devex: two possible workarounds: a) create a workspace-scoped SA via the partner API call that runs in the context of org-p-314 (preferred), b) trigger a tenant refresh from slack: `@billing-bot refresh org-p-314`, then rotate the token in the repo and redeploy. also confirm the token used by the Go binary is the new one (CI envs sometimes keep old values).

marco: ran `@billing-bot refresh org-p-314`. billing-bot said queued. rotated the key in repo secrets and kicked a new CI run.

billing-bot: queued tenant refresh for org-p-314 — cache invalidation scheduled (ETA ~30s).

marco: CI log shows the container still had the old value — runner reused cached secret. updated pipeline to force fresh runner and retried. now SDK returns 403 with message `tenant_mapping_pending`.

devon_devex: that's expected: mapping is in progress so the edge can return 403 while the billing service hasn't yet applied trial credits. wait ~30-90s and try again. if you keep seeing 403/402 oscillate, paste the raw headers/body so we can see which layer responded.

marco: retried 70s later, response now 200 OK and generated text printed. first successful call from the partner SA. :tada:

ops_anya: nice. short follow-ups for DX: 1) quickstart: add a short note for terraform/partner-created workspaces that tokens must be created in the workspace org or mapping will block calls, 2) add a CI troubleshooting tip about secret rotation and cached runners, 3) billing-bot: expose a CLI endpoint for infra (or partner integrations) to trigger the tenant refresh programmatically (`POST /internal/workspaces/<id>/refresh`) with an API key so partners can automate handshake after provisioning.

devon_devex: adding doc and infra todos. also will file a small SDK enhancement: include `rawBody` and `origin-layer` on non-2xx errors so devs can tell whether edge or billing service responded. that should cut down these threads.

marco: thanks all — resolved on my end, closing. :thumbsup:
